name: Houkago☆Lesson ~Yamitsuki! Futari no Ecchi na Kagai Jugyou~
original_name: 放課後☆レッスン ～やみつき！二人のエッチな課外授業～
source:
Seiji is a rookie teacher. But there is his ex-girlfriend, Mizuka, at his school. They are surprised to meet again...., but it doesn't take long until they fall in love again. They meet secretly after school, but one day, Midori, a school counselor, finds out their relationship....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090207134640/http://erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1007146]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
诚二是一名新手教师。但他的前女友水香也在同一所学校。两人惊讶地重逢了……但没过多久他们就再次坠入爱河。他们在放学后秘密约会，但有一天，学校心理咨询师碧发现了他们的关系……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090207134640/http://erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1007146]Eroge Shop[/url]]
